create_DictVectorizer: create a DictVectorizer to transform token frequency dictionaries into feature matrices
create_FeatureHasher: create a FeatureHasher to vectorize text documents using hash-based feature mapping
create_CountVectorizer: create a CountVectorizer to tokenize raw text and build a bag-of-words feature matrix
create_HashingVectorizer: create a HashingVectorizer to tokenize and hash raw text into a sparse feature matrix
create_TfidfVectorizer: create a TfidfVectorizer to tokenize text and apply term-frequency inverse-document-frequency weighting
